title: A finite affine morphism admits a finite section-covered ambient scheme
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of schemes with $X$ affine [def-pc-scheme]. There exist an affine scheme $X\prime$, a surjective finite locally free morphism $a:X\prime\to X$ [def-weil-surjective-morphism, def-pc-finite-locally-free], an affine scheme $W$, and a finite locally free morphism $p:W\to X\prime$, together with a closed immersion $j:Y\prime=Y\times_X X\prime\hookrightarrow W$ over $X\prime$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-closed-immersion]. There is a finite family of closed subschemes $W_k\hookrightarrow W$ whose underlying sets cover $W$, and each restriction $p|_{W_k}:W_k\to X\prime$ is an isomorphism. The projection $Y\prime\to Y$ is also surjective finite locally free. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 03HW, label lemma-massage-finite, clauses (1)-(5); affineness of X\prime and W follows from the finite morphisms in the same statement.
